stage8.title: Asha'man, Kill! (Dumai's Wells)
stage8.doc: Stage 8 Dumai's Wells. Nordic folk metal war chant: deep male choir, gang shouts, frame drums and taiko, hurdy-gurdy drone. The loop runs verse -> pre-chorus -> 'Asha'man, kill!' chorus (about 12 s in) -> kulning post-chorus -> bridge -> chorus (39 s) -> bridge -> final chorus (60 s), then the last 'kill!' falls back into the verse.

measured.note: Requested 120 BPM; onset autocorrelation and the beat grid put the take at ~122-125.5 BPM (it settles near 125 after the intro). The loop is 128 tracked beats (32 bars), 33.07 s -> 94.56 s, snapped to whole MP3 frames.

source.vocals: Chorus 'Asha'man, kill!' (Whisper word times in the take: 45.2 s, 72.1 s, 93.1 s) all sit inside the loop window.

boss8.title: Queen of Love and Beauty
boss8.doc: Stage 8 boss duel with Lanfear. Instrumental dark symphonic folk metal in 3/4: soaring wordless soprano, nordic male choir, ostinato, war drums and brass. No lyrics, so nothing fights Lanfear's lines.

measured.note: Requested 140 BPM; the take holds a steady 184 BPM (every 10 s window 183.9-184.2) in triple meter (bass onsets on every third beat). The loop is 204 beats (68 bars of 3/4) from the downbeat at 20.70 s.
